name: Fleetbound

classes.doctrine: Fleet-wide rule inherited by every vessel unless explicitly superseded by Admiral governance.
classes.capability: Reusable primitive that must be adapted to mission/users/data/risk before adoption.
classes.mission_adapter: Project-specific implementation; never copied across vessels as-is.

transfer_rule: Learn -> classify -> adapt -> Captain review -> adopt. No business-specific data or branding transfers automatically.

learnings.title: Doctrine Inheritance
learnings.lesson: True fleet doctrine is inherited automatically by every admitted vessel and proven centrally; it must not create repetitive per-vessel review chores.
learnings.missionAdapter: Fleet law applies automatically while vessel-specific implementation evidence remains isolated.

learnings.title: Recommendation Compression
learnings.lesson: Many raw project matches must be compressed into a small number of mission-aware Admiral decisions, with shared deficiencies grouped as fleet patterns.
learnings.missionAdapter: Show the Admiral decisions, not the bookkeeping that produced them.

learnings.title: Mission-Fit Confidence
learnings.lesson: Reusable capabilities must explain why they fit each vessel. Strong fits may be staged together; plausible fits require review; experimental fits are suppressed from bulk staging.
learnings.missionAdapter: Never infer capability fit from a weak proxy such as photo availability alone.

learnings.title: Manufacturability-Aware Composition Fit
learnings.lesson: Treat customer layout as usable-face geometry + scale + optical placement together; preserve the exact source image/material and let each vessel define its own mission-specific fit behavior.

learnings.title: Show the result beside the action
learnings.lesson: Use explicit saving, saved, or retry feedback beside the control; confirm persistence before claiming success.
learnings.missionAdapter: Pilot in quotes and invoices; test failed saves and navigation before expanding.

learnings.title: Keep controls with the work
learnings.lesson: Keep essential tools and the next action visible; reduce decoration before reducing usable control sizes.
learnings.missionAdapter: Pilot in the Carvewright drawing workspace; retain access to job details and allow necessary document scrolling.

learnings.title: Separate the tool from the input device
learnings.lesson: A finger or Pencil chooses an input device; Draw, Shapes and Select define the action. Switching devices must not silently choose a shape.
learnings.missionAdapter: Review canvas tools only. Recheck menu dismissal, pen-to-finger transitions and undo.

learnings.title: Finish in the context of the job
learnings.lesson: Completion should explain what was completed and offer the relevant next step, while preserving a way back.
learnings.missionAdapter: Review each workflow separately: a flight lands; an invoice confirms its saved state; a design returns to its own job.

learnings.title: Give animation a clear lifetime
learnings.lesson: Use readable pacing, reduced-motion support, hidden-tab pause and immediate exit. Cancel callbacks when leaving a view.
learnings.missionAdapter: Use subtle feedback where business work benefits; never delay a user action for a celebration.

learnings.title: Keep playful variety in learning activities
learnings.lesson: Vary solvable number patterns and celebrate flight completion with a short firework display.
learnings.missionAdapter: Wonderwake only by default. Do not automatically add game rewards, fireworks or random choices to business workflows.

learnings.title: One account can serve several people
learnings.lesson: Keep account access, traveler identity and trip participation distinct.
learnings.missionAdapter: Adapt to learner profiles or purchaser/recipient relationships; do not transfer private travel preferences.

learnings.title: Know whose preference it is
learnings.lesson: Retain the subject, reporter, source, scope and confirmation for preferences.
learnings.missionAdapter: Review account/person permissions and correction workflows for each vessel.

learnings.title: Weather needs place, time and freshness
learnings.lesson: Retain forecast source, update time, location and alternatives. Label stale or unavailable data.
learnings.missionAdapter: Consider weather-sensitive scheduling only after local requirements and forecast limits are tested.

learnings.title: Change the remaining day, retain its history
learnings.lesson: Keep completed, skipped and unavailable events separate from suggestions, with undo.
learnings.missionAdapter: Adapt to mission-specific event history without rewriting prior evidence.

learnings.title: Keep the engine separate from the destination
learnings.lesson: Support arbitrary locations, custom ideas, multiple stays and local timezones; research packs are optional.
learnings.missionAdapter: Reuse the separation of operating logic and location data after mission review.

learnings.title: Practice a missed skill in a different setting
learnings.lesson: Reuse the local course and scorecard in fleet_practice_circuit.js. The host supplies its own station content, rules and alternate setting. First reads and transfer attempts are counted separately.
learnings.missionAdapter: Captain reviews the lesson before adoption. Each program keeps its own session and results.

confidence_rubric.strong: Mission evidence directly supports staging; bulk stage may include these matches.
confidence_rubric.plausible: Useful fit, but mission adaptation or authority evidence should be reviewed before staging.
confidence_rubric.experimental: Weak or indirect fit; automatically excluded from bulk staging and surfaced only as suppressed evidence.
